decisive_spans.text: mucinous fluid and membranes were extracted

response.rationale: The presence of 'mucinous fluid and membranes were extracted' strongly supports D7 and D10. D7 is slightly better as it also accounts for the imaging findings of a 'multiloculated lesion that was hypointense on T1, hyperintense on T2, communicating with the biliary bifurcation, with dilatation of intrahepatic ducts (predominantly left) and of the common bile duct containing heterogeneous signal material', which is more comprehensive than D10's support. D8 is contradicted by negative hydatid serology. D4 and D9 are contradicted by the presence of mucinous fluid and membranes.
